item.text: `get_relevant_context` currently does a symbolic BM25 lookup with `entity_index.search_records()` over each record’s `rdfs:label` and description, weighting the label `2.0` and the description `1.0`, then returns the top-ranked matches for the topic. It no longer uses the older label-only `search_classes` path or any absolute relevance floor. [get_relevant_context topic search: search_records (BM25 over label + description) replaces search_classes (label-only)](https://moosedev.dev/kg/ArchitecturalDecision/c8bce03b-6902-491a-9068-469f53b05928)
